title: 第17章 忠诚度低于六十无法加入第18章 凡人修仙诀
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费
content_zh:
“你.....到底是谁？”肖曦儿终于开始正视苏白了。
苏白将她看透了，而她对苏白却什么都不知道。
这种感觉令她心悸，莫非这个少年，真的是某些隐藏的老怪物，特意跑出来历练的？
“我是肖岩的师尊，你说我是谁？”苏白轻笑一声。
肖曦儿不说话了，而此刻，肖岩也正好从仙法阁走了出来。
“师尊，弟子已经找到了适合自己的仙法了！”
他一出来，便捧着卷轴跪在苏白的面前，一副欣喜若狂的模样。
“嗯，甚好！”苏白点了点头，仙法阁中的事情，他早已经知道了。
炼体，也是一条前途无量的路！
“肖岩哥哥可以修炼了？”肖曦儿再一次被惊住了，满脸的难以置信。
肖岩的体质问题，可是连影叔都无法解决，更加别说提供修炼之法了！
“师尊，不知修炼这仙法，需要多少银子？”肖岩急切的问道。
虽然心中知道这鸿蒙炼体诀很珍贵，需要的银子可能是他无法承受的，但他也想尝试一下。
能够修炼，他什么都愿意付出！
“每个加入宗门的弟子，都可以免费选择一部仙法，自然无需银子。”苏白摇了摇头。
“免费？”肖岩愣了片刻后，激动不已，连忙跪在苏白的面前：“师尊在上，再受徒儿一拜。”
“好了，你先去修炼吧，争取早日达到肉身境。”苏白挥手道。
炼体的境界，始于肉身，肉身境也有九重，与炼气九重对应。
“多谢师尊。”肖岩站起身来，恭敬离去。
而后，他便盘膝坐下，仔细阅读起手中的鸿蒙练体诀。

不过，当他看见第一页时，便倒吸了一口冷气。
一刻钟负重100斤长跑十里！
负重100斤连续俯卧撑一百个！
皮鞭连续抽打100下！
完成以上任务的肉身强度，才有资格正式修炼！（注：修仙世界普通人的体质比正常的要高一点）
这一套下来，饶是以肖岩的毅力和忍耐力，额头上都浮现出一丝汗珠。
肖曦儿也看到了训练内容，当即只觉得浑身一颤。
这是没有修炼过的普通人可以完成的吗？
“肖岩哥哥，要不别修炼了吧？”她担忧的劝阻道。
这一套下去，怕是要丢了半条命吧？
连肖岩都有些怕了，他从小除了别人异样的眼光也没吃过什么苦，哪里承受得住这等折磨？
苏白瞥了他们两人一眼，淡淡一笑道：“怎么，三年之后，你想依然被柳嫣然踩在脚下吗？”
“这.......”肖岩咬牙，双拳捏得咔嚓作响。
最终，他狠狠地攥着卷轴，一字一句道：“我要变强，我要赢柳嫣然！”
“我要证明，我肖岩不会比任何人差！”
他眼睛通红，整张脸都憋的紫青，显然用尽全身力气才喊了出来。
说完，他立马起身，开始围着天道宗的山脚下奔跑而去。
他要证明自己，要变强！
这时，苏白目光一瞥，见诸葛风与萧灵汐都在一旁看着，当即道：“去修炼吧，宗门的实力还要看你们的努力程度。”
诸葛风与萧灵汐闻言，并没有准备修炼，而是将目光看向一旁的肖曦儿。

很显然，他们修炼的仙法太超绝，如果被外人看到了........
content_en:
"Who...are you?" Xiao Xi'er finally began to look at Su Bai.
Su Bai saw through her, but she knew nothing about Su Bai.
This feeling made her palpitate. Could it be that this young man was really some hidden old monster who came out specially to gain experience?
"I am Xiao Yan's master, who do you think I am?" Su Bai chuckled.
Xiao Xi'er stopped talking, and at this moment, Xiao Yan just walked out of the Immortal Law Pavilion.
"Master, this disciple has found the immortal method that suits him!"
As soon as he came out, he held the scroll and knelt in front of Su Bai, looking ecstatic.
"Well, very good!" Su Bai nodded. He already knew what happened in the Immortal Law Pavilion.
Body training is also a promising path!
"Brother Xiao Yan, can you practice?" Xiao Xi'er was shocked again, with disbelief on her face.
Even Uncle Ying couldn't solve Xiao Yan's physical problem, let alone provide him with a method of cultivation!
"Master, I wonder how much money is needed to practice this immortal method?" Xiao Yan asked eagerly.
Although he knew in his heart that the Hongmeng Body Refining Technique was very precious and the money required might be beyond his affordability, he still wanted to try it.
To be able to practice, he is willing to give anything!
"Every disciple who joins the sect can choose an immortal method for free, naturally without any money." Su Bai shook his head.
"Free?" Xiao Yan was stunned for a moment, then became excited and quickly knelt down in front of Su Bai: "Master, please bow to me again."
"Okay, you go to practice first and try to reach the physical state as soon as possible." Su Bai waved his hand.
The realm of body refining begins with the physical body, which also has nine levels, corresponding to the nine levels of Qi refining.
"Thank you, Master." Xiao Yan stood up and left respectfully.
Then, he sat down cross-legged and carefully read the Hongmeng Body Training Technique in his hand.
However, when he saw the first page, he gasped.
Run ten miles with a weight of 100 kilograms in a quarter of an hour!
One hundred push-ups in a row with a weight of 100 pounds!
100 lashes with the whip!
Only those who have the physical strength to complete the above tasks are qualified to practice formally! (Note: The physique of ordinary people in the world of cultivating immortals is a little higher than normal)
After doing this, even with Xiao Yan's perseverance and endurance, a trace of sweat appeared on his forehead.
Xiao Xi'er also saw the training content and immediately felt trembling all over.
Is this something that ordinary people who have not practiced cultivation can accomplish?
"Brother Xiao Yan, why don't you stop practicing?" she discouraged worriedly.
If this continues, I'm afraid half of my life will be lost, right?
Even Xiao Yan was a little scared. He had never suffered anything except the strange looks from others since he was a child. How could he withstand such torture?
Su Bai glanced at the two of them, smiled faintly and said, "What, three years later, do you want to still be stepped on by Liu Yanran?"
"This..." Xiao Yan gritted his teeth and clenched his fists.
In the end, he held the scroll tightly and said word by word: "I want to become stronger, I want to defeat Liu Yanran!"
"I want to prove that I, Xiao Yan, am no worse than anyone else!"
His eyes were red and his whole face was purple and blue from holding back. It was obvious that he had used all his strength to shout.
After saying that, he immediately stood up and started running around the foot of the Tiandao Sect's mountain.
He wants to prove himself and become stronger!
At this time, Su Bai glanced and saw Zhuge Feng and Xiao Lingxi watching from the side, and immediately said: "Go and practice. The strength of the sect depends on your efforts."
When Zhuge Feng and Xiao Lingxi heard this, they did not prepare to practice, but looked at Xiao Xi'er who was standing aside.
Obviously, the immortal magic they practice is too extraordinary. If outsiders see it...
